documentation.content: No successful HTTP response from the scheduled account-deletion-worker in europe-west3 with a 5-minute alignment window plus a 24h55m retest window (25h total API evaluation limit). Uses the live-verified Cloud Run DELTA request_count, summed across revisions, with response_code_class=2xx. Missing data is treated as violating after the retest duration. This observes invocation liveness only: HTTP 2xx does not establish that pending deletions or Apple token revocations completed. Inspect the Scheduler state, service errors and deletion queue separately; never replay a deletion merely to test this alert. See docs/runbooks/ops-alerts.md#04. Before creation, apply_alerts requires a positive matching 2xx time series in the preceding 24 hours.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.label."project_id"="ko-lernen-app" AND resource.label."location"="europe-west3" AND resource.label."service_name"="account-deletion-worker" AND metric.type="run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND metric.label."response_code_class"="2xx"

_requires: Successful matching Cloud Run 2xx time series in preceding 24h, verified by apply_alerts.py before creation. The 25h outage alert itself still needs operational validation.
